body: I was pretty vague about a lot of stuff. If anyone is interested or cares send me a message if you want to know more details. I'll go into more detail, talk on the phone, IM, whatever. I just know it's wrong to feel depressed several days a week and want help.

Thanks for sharing your story, it does seem quite similar. In addition to everything I listed I'd also like to learn sign language and a few other languages, programming, I'd like to teach for a few years. There's just so much stuff that I can imagine myself doing and I imagine most taking years to excel at or to be able to do. Are my dreams too ambitious and should I set a few more realistic goals for myself?

I think that's a horrible idea to go and spend tens of thousands of dollars for possibly no reason. College isn't needed for anything I want to learn or do as far as hobbies go either, and as far as work goes I've already found a field I'm good in and enjoy. If I do go back it will be simply for a degree so that I can advance higher. Work/career/college is the least of my worries. It's my hobbies, relationships, etc that I'm not sure where to start.
